title: FirstMate and AgentSwitchboard convergence floor
intent: Record the durable AgentSwitchboard ↔ FirstMate ownership, runtime, safety, and stale-PR salvage boundaries after integrating the Windows-to-WSL bridge contract without merging the behind-main FirstMate PR stack and without vendoring FirstMate.

roles.AgentSwitchboard: control plane / workstation-bootstrap convergence: environment readiness, provider policy, validators, evidence sinks, and escalation — not a second live crew orchestrator
roles.FirstMate: crew chief / canonical live crew runtime: decompose and supervise parallel crew work under AgentSwitchboard policy while preserving isolated repository work
roles.codingAgents: workers: bounded reasoning, edits, tests, and reports inside assigned branches or worktrees
roles.tmux: reference session backend: terminal/session substrate only; does not own project decomposition or AgentSwitchboard policy

runtime.wslSupportClaim: AgentSwitchboard integration inference from upstream Linux support; upstream README does not explicitly certify WSL

upstream.rebaseNote: Historical FirstMate PR #96/#98/#99/#100/#101 remain salvage evidence only. FM-REFRESH-06 and FM-BRIDGE-10 rebuild durable foundation/bridge behavior on current main; do not merge the stale stack as-is.
upstream.pinRefreshRule: Current audited pin is FirstMate main at the ADR evidence floor. Historical PR #96 audit commit remains provenance only and must not be treated as current interop proof.

windowsBridge.skillCapabilityTriggerDisposition: No ASB FirstMate crew skill/capability/trigger is registered. Historical ASB route-selector/crew-skill surfaces are intentionally not revived because FirstMate owns live dispatch and lifecycle.

herdr.note: Herdr is deferred and experimental-unproved. It is not part of Windows Admin Box native bootstrap now.

dependencyOrder.summary: Foundation source material; durable Linux/WSL foundation rebuilt by FM-REFRESH-06
Explicit Ubuntu, bounded WSL, unique evidence roots; salvaged by FM-BRIDGE-10
Prerequisite gate before physical floor; salvaged by FM-BRIDGE-10
Windows-native contract front door; salvaged by FM-BRIDGE-10
Windows Python interpreter-continuity evidence; salvaged as current-interpreter execution in FM-BRIDGE-10

stalePrStack.integrationRule: Do not merge the stale stack. Treat it as historical failure/evidence input and keep only behavior rebuilt and validated on current main.

claims: Tracked convergence, pin, integration, and Windows bridge contracts exist and parse
FirstMate remains the canonical live crew runtime and Windows remains bridge-only
Hosted validation can exercise the Windows-native contract front door without invoking physical WSL
The bridge contract enforces explicit Ubuntu, bounded WSL processes, CRLF normalization, empty-stream safety, WSLENV path transport, and a WSL-owned standalone exact-head clone
The physical-floor wrapper checks git, gh, tmux, python3, and GitHub authentication before bridge execution without installing dependencies or mutating credentials
Historical AgentSwitchboard FirstMate route-selector and crew-skill runtime ownership is not revived
doesNotClaim: live FirstMate crew dispatch or supervision

operatorNext.when: After FM-BRIDGE-10 integrates, execute the prerequisite-gated physical floor on an authorized Windows Admin Box. A PASS proves only the Windows→Ubuntu/WSL interoperability floor; the local-only FirstMate crew pilot remains a separate successor.
operatorNext.optionalFirstMateHint: Add -FirstMatePath <path> only when the audited FirstMate checkout is not discoverable inside Ubuntu.
operatorNext.note: The prerequisite gate observes required tools and GitHub authentication but never installs packages or logs in on the operator's behalf. Local evidence remains untracked.

architectureDecision.binding: FirstMate is the canonical live crew runtime; AgentSwitchboard owns workstation/bootstrap convergence, readiness, policy, validation, and evidence sinks and must not expand the child-agent bus into a second crew orchestration platform.
